description: Set up comprehensive repository infrastructure including contribution guidelines, issue/PR templates, CI workflows, and project documentation. This will establish a standardized development workflow and make the project more accessible to contributors.
functional_requirements: Create GitHub issue templates for bug reports and feature requests with appropriate fields
Set up a pull request template to guide contributors through the submission process
Configure GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration testing
Create comprehensive documentation including CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md
Ensure proper licensing and dependency management configuration
